description:
Look up five specific chemicals on the CAMEO Chemicals website (https://cameochemicals.noaa.gov/) to assess their water reactivity hazards. The chemicals are: Sodium (CAS 7440-23-5), Calcium Carbide (CAS 75-20-7), Acetone (CAS 67-64-1), Potassium (CAS 7440-09-7), and Ethanol (CAS 64-17-5).

For each chemical:
1. Search for it by name.
2. Navigate to its Datasheet.
3. Read the 'Air & Water Reactions' section.
4. Determine if it is water-reactive (YES/NO).
5. Note any hazardous gases produced (e.g., hydrogen, acetylene).

Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/water_reactivity_report.txt'. The report must list each chemical, its classification (Water-Reactive: YES or NO), and a brief description of the reaction/hazards found.
